name: Model Config
description: Retrieve the provider's defaults for a given model (context window, loaded state, family) and emit a recommended max_tokens. Per-model skill notebooks should start by composing this skill so their downstream parameter choices are grounded in what the provider actually advertises (e.g. LM Studio's /api/v0/models/{id} endpoint). Documentation lives in the skill notebook itself (markdown cells).

model.description: Provider-prefixed model id, e.g. lm_studio/google/gemma-4-31b. Defaults to the notebook's configured client.

base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Defaults to the notebook's configured client.

headroom_tokens.description: Tokens to reserve below the context window for the prompt when computing recommended_max_tokens.
